items.title: Endomorphisms of an injective hull of the residue field form the completion of the local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the endomorphism ring of an injective hull of the residue field of a Noetherian local ring with the completion of that ring (author lemma at source lines 1082-1087, label lemma-endos). The proof (source lines 1089-1099) writes the hull as the union of the submodules killed by the powers of the maximal ideal, notes that endomorphisms preserve this filtration, and evaluates the resulting limit termwise, where each term is the corresponding quotient of the local ring. The passage to the limit is the substance. H2.
